subject: Concordance: open cross-functional asks & QBR exec prep
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 18:02:00 -0800
Subject: Concordance: open cross-functional asks & QBR exec prep

Folks — following today's xfn sync, consolidated the open asks and owners below. Goal: have a clean deck for exec review by EOD Tue 12/8 so we can land asks for the QBR. Please reply with any corrections or updated dates inline.

Action items (owner — current due):
1) Exec ask slide content (owner: Marissa) — draft due Mon 12/7 12:00pm PT. I need 2 bullets per ask + impact metric. Attachment: QBR_exec_ask_slides.pdf (stub).
2) Pricing exception summary for Dedicated customers (owner: Karthik) — initial numbers due Mon 12/7 5:00pm PT.
3) Security/compliance evidence roll-up for private deployments (owner: Lauren) — need SOC2 matrix & one-pager by Tue 12/8 9:00am PT.
4) Mutual action plan with ScaleData (owner: Vivek) — finalize responsibilities & sign-off; initial MAD draft by Mon 12/7. Attachment: mutual_action_plan_v2.docx (stub).
5) Quantization/Optimize guidance for large sequence workloads (owner: Karthik + Marissa) — proposed config by Tue 12/8 EOD.

Notes: Please flag any items you cannot meet and propose alternate owners/dates. I will compile changes and produce an exec-ready packet.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Platform Partnerships (interim)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 08:15:23 -0800
Subject: Re: Concordance: open cross-functional asks & QBR exec prep

Thanks Vivek — quick updates inline.

1) Exec ask slide content: I can take this but will need the impact metric for the e2e latency reduction experiment. Can the infra team confirm tokens/sec improvement by EOD Mon? I attached a cleaned starter deck (QBR_exec_ask_slides.pdf) with placeholders.

2) Pricing exception: I'll partner with Karthik on the margin calc; Karthik, can you confirm whether we factor in burst capacity credits when modeling monthly commit?

3) Security/compliance evidence: Lauren, per the security intake, we have a partial SOC2 artifacts set. I pulled logs and certs into an evidence roll-up — see security_evidence_rollup.xlsx (attachment stub). Note: one outstanding ask is encryption key rotation proof from Private customers (we may need a short ask to infra).

4) MAD with ScaleData: Vivek, added a line item for billing handoff and a risk row (mutual_action_plan_v2.docx). Kate @ScaleData will want a 48-hour review window; please confirm.

5) Quantization/Optimize guidance: I can draft recommendations but need a use-case split (short seq vs long seq). Karthik, can you add expected seq distribution?

Quoted for context:
> On Sat, Dec 5, 2026 at 6:02 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Folks — following today's xfn sync...

Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 09:02:11 -0800
Subject: Re: Concordance: open cross-functional asks & QBR exec prep

Ack — I can own pricing exception calc and the quantization guidance (will coordinate with Marissa on seq distribution).

Quick note: for pricing, please assume 10% burst utilization for modeling unless Finance pushes back; I'll surface sensitivity bounds.

On the SOC2 rotation evidence: if we can't get rotation proofs from customers in time, propose we include an executive note describing next-step mitigation and target date. Lauren / Security to confirm.

Karthik
Head of Pricing (acting)
From: Kate Johnson <kate@scaledata.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 11:10:47 -0800
Subject: Re: Concordance: open cross-functional asks & QBR exec prep

Hi Vivek / Marissa — thanks for the draft. A couple of questions from ScaleData ops:
1) We can't commit to a 48-hour review window for the MAD; two business days is tight for our legal — can we do 5 business days?
2) For the billing handoff line item: who will be the Redwood PM responsible for the invoice format?

Also, Marissa, can you share the SOC2 artifact list you mentioned? That will help our procurement attach the right evidence.

Regards,
Kate Johnson
Head of Partnerships
ScaleData
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: kate@scaledata.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 06 Dec 2026 13:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Concordance: open cross-functional asks & QBR exec prep

Kate — thanks, good to surface those constraints early. Responses below: 

1) MAD review window: 5 business days is acceptable; adjust the timeline in mutual_action_plan_v2.docx and call out expected review date (I will update and re-circulate by Mon 12/7 10:00am PT).

2) Billing handoff owner: Marissa will be the Redwood PM responsible for the invoice format and will own the handoff checklist. Marissa — can you confirm you have bandwidth?

3) SOC2 artifact list: Marissa attached security_evidence_rollup.xlsx in her reply — link copied here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bQBR-prep. If ScaleData procurement needs a flattened CSV of artifacts, let me know and we'll produce one by Tue 12/8.

Next steps (short):
- Marissa: finalize exec slides draft (Mon 12/7 12:00pm PT).
- Karthik: pricing exception numbers & quantization guidance (Mon 12/7 5:00pm PT).
- Lauren: SOC2 matrix one-pager or mitigation note (Tue 12/8 9:00am PT).
- Vivek: update MAD with 5-business-day review and recirculate (Mon 12/7 10:00am PT).

I'll compile final packet and share to the HUBSPOT deal and Drive links above.

Thanks all — please flag any changes ASAP.

Vivek
